owner_creation.analysis: src/safe_core/mod.rs declares the isolated component and scalar errors. The module declares the isolated component modules and a small Copy StorageError enum whose only payload is an interior-NUL offset.
owner_creation.invariant: Error values own scalar diagnostic metadata only.
limitations: The separate tools/safety/core manifest compiles this root; src/lib.rs does not include it in the production pager.
StorageError owns only scalar metadata, not the failing byte owner.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/safe_core/mod.rs re-exports APIs without transferring byte owners. Re-exports move no byte ownership; StorageError copies cannot alias ByteBuf data or arena slot values.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Module exports create no hidden storage aliases.
limitations: Re-exporting ByteBuf does not analyze its application integration.

callback_targets.analysis: src/safe_core/mod.rs contains no runtime callback registration. There are no function bodies, callback registrations or initializers here; ReserveFault is re-exported only for test or fault-testing configuration.
callback_targets.invariant: The module root creates no runtime callback.
limitations: There is no runtime callable target in this declaration-only module.

invalidation.analysis: src/safe_core/mod.rs keeps owner lifetimes in concrete modules. StorageError values have no borrowed lifetime to expire; owner-specific invalidation remains in bytebuf and arena implementations.
invalidation.invariant: Diagnostic metadata cannot outlive a borrowed pointee.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/safe_core/mod.rs forbids unsafe code in the isolated crate. Forbid(unsafe_code) applies to this separate crate and its modules; declaration order performs no partial runtime allocation commit.
mutation_commit.invariant: Component construction cannot insert unsafe code here.

release_pair.analysis: src/safe_core/mod.rs defines no manual resource destructor. The enum and exports need no free/close pair; their concrete owning modules supply ordinary Rust destruction.
release_pair.invariant: Root metadata has no manual release operation.
limitations: Concrete arena and bytebuf modules retain their own destruction obligations.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/safe_core/mod.rs represents errors without allocating strings. Errors do not allocate a context String, so a failed reserve can return an enum without constructing a second allocation-dependent diagnostic owner.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/safe_core/mod.rs declares no asynchronous application dispatch. The header states this crate is not linked into pager binaries; it declares no asynchronous dispatch or mutable process state.
signals_handoff.invariant: Component review does not certify production handoff.
